description: Create or update the root `.gitignore` file for a PHP/Composer project — `vendor/`, Composer credentials (`auth.json`), PHPUnit/Pest caches (`.phpunit.cache/`, `.phpunit.result.cache`), report output (`build/` holding `build/logs/clover.xml`/`junit.xml` and coverage HTML), quality-tool caches (PHP-CS-Fixer, PHPCS, a PHPStan `tmpDir` inside the project), env files (keeping `.env.example`), OS and editor noise, the repository-wide `.integration-test.lock/` directory, the UI tests' screenshot directory `.ui-screenshots/` (every flavor renders UI) — and, when detected, flavor-specific paths for a Laravel application (following the Laravel skeleton's own `.gitignore`: `public/build`, `public/hot`, `public/storage`, `storage/*.key`, IDE-helper files), a WordPress plugin or block theme (`node_modules/`, `@wordpress/scripts` `build/` output, release `*.zip`, `.wp-env.override.json`), Playwright browser UI test output (`test-results/`, `playwright-report/`, `blob-report/`, `/playwright/.cache/`, plus `@wordpress/scripts`' `artifacts/` for WordPress), a PrestaShop module (`config_*.xml` caches, release `*.zip`, while `config.xml` stays tracked), and an Antora docs build. Never ignores `composer.lock` (committed for apps, plugins, themes, and modules alike). Invoke as `/iru-setup-php-gitignore`, optionally with an `args` line setting `on-existing` to `ask`/`keep`/`update`/`replace` (default `ask`) for scripted runs. Announces whether it is creating `.gitignore` from scratch or updating an existing one; if one already exists it never overwrites it silently — it warns, shows the proposed merge as a diff, and asks Update (merge, keeping hand-added entries) / Keep as is / Replace (template only, hand-added entries lost). Mirrors `iru-setup-typescript-gitignore` and `iru-setup-java-gitignore` for the PHP ecosystem. Use whenever a Laravel, WordPress, PrestaShop, or plain Composer project needs a `.gitignore` bootstrapped from scratch, or an existing one checked against this house template without touching it unless the user approves.
